pages.title: D-Brane Sheet
pages.text: A surface on which open strings can end, with its own dynamics and its own charge. Our universe could be a three-dimensional D-brane floating in higher dimensions. The sheet ripples like silk, and strings seem to cling to it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stretching quantum strings across metamaterial with brane tension fiber in the Compactification Lathe, I noticed their ends stuck to the sheet. Exotic matter held it rigid enough to keep.
Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Singularity, M-Brane.
